verdict.rationale: Heap documents its own bulk API endpoints: a Bulk Track endpoint that accepts up to 1000 events per request and a user-deletion endpoint that accepts up to 10,000 users per request. These are genuine first-party bulk operations, but they cover only event ingestion and user deletion, with no evidence of broader bulk editing or management across items. Missing for 10: bulk update/edit operations across users, accounts, or definitions; bulk operations outside ingestion and deletion; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: it takes an `events` array of objects with a max of 1000 events per request.
Up to 10,000 users can be submitted in a single request.
